read.en: Broadcom fell 4.3% on Oct 22 to $323.24, trading between $321.02 and $330.82 on volume 1.3 times its 20-day average. It is below all its falling averages: 5-day ($331.8), 10-day ($342.3), 30-day ($350.9), 100-day ($376.1) and 200-day ($367.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 15 and below zero, with the histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($362.58), and RSI is 35.
read.zh: 博通 10月22日下跌 4.3%，收于 $323.24，盘中区间 $321.02–330.82，成交量为 20 日均量的 1.3 倍。股价位于所有下行均线下方：5 日（$331.8）、10 日（$342.3）、30 日（$350.9）、100 日（$376.1）和 200 日均线（$367.9）。MACD 自 10月15日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$362.58），RSI 为 35。

read.en: The drop broke the $335 and $328.6 supports, now resistance; the close is testing the $321.4–324.1 Dec 17 and Oct 10, 2025 lows. Resistance is $328.6–331.8 (Oct 16 low, 5-day), then $335–336 and $341–342 (Oct 20 high, 10-day). Support is $321–324, then $314.1 (Jan 23 low) and $307–308.5. A close below $321 would open $314; a close above $331.8 would target $335–341.
